coder_notes: M032 is an oncolytic virus (excluded intervention type); pembrolizumab is the only pharmacological investigational agent, coded experimental_monotherapy as in the manual's pembrolizumab + vaccine example. Temozolomide listed because the newly diagnosed cohort receives it per protocol text (not a registered intervention; 'as determined by treating physician'). Unmethylated MGMT is mentioned only as an eligibility allowance in recurrent patients, not an entry requirement, so no MGMT row. Mixed recurrent and newly diagnosed cohorts.
